name: D'ark
source:
Somewhere lies a beautiful island, which for centuries has been the battle ground for the titanic war between the forces of Light and Darkness. No side was able to control the island for a long time; after a while, the war raged anew, and the island fell under the control of the other side.

Forty years ago, the Light, represented by human being, prevailed in the latest battle. The island was occupied by humans. One day, a strange-looking man appeared on it. He had no memory of his own past, except his name, Dulldeek, and the hatred to humans. Without knowing what this hatred was caused by, Dulldeek feels the rage of the Dark inside him. He decides to infiltrate the castle of Veevik, the humans' fortress, to satisfy his burning anger...

D'ark is a very simple solo first-person dungeon crawler. As Dulldeek, the player navigates maze-like pseudo-3D dungeons (with auto-mapping), encountering randomly appearing enemies and fighting them in turn-based combat to gain experience points and level up. The magic system is very basic, the sole choice being "attack spell" or "healing spell", both of which consume magic points. A somewhat unusual feature is the option to turn off random encounters completely at any time.
translation:
某个地方坐落着一座美丽的岛屿，几个世纪以来，这里一直是光明与黑暗势力之间激烈战争的战场。没有一方能够长期控制该岛；过了一段时间，战事再次爆发，岛屿落入对方的控制之下。

四十年前，以人类为代表的圣光在最近的一场战斗中取得了胜利。该岛曾被人类占领。有一天，上面出现了一名相貌奇特的男子。他对自己的过去没有任何记忆，除了他的名字，杜尔戴克，以及对人类的仇恨。不知道这种仇恨是由什么引起的，杜尔戴克感受到了他体内黑暗力量的愤怒。他决定潜入人类的堡垒维维克城堡，来满足自己熊熊燃烧的愤怒……

D'ark是一款非常简单的第一人称地下城探索游戏。作为Dulldeek，玩家在迷宫般的伪3D地下城（带有自动映射）中导航，遇到随机出现的敌人并在回合制战斗中与他们战斗以获得经验值和升级。魔法系统非常基础，唯一的选择就是“攻击法术”或“治疗法术”，两者都消耗魔法值。一个有点不寻常的功能是可以随时完全关闭随机遭遇的选项。
